instrument: Siglent oscilloscope (SDS1000X-E / SDS2000X Plus / SDS800X HD / SDS3000X HD)
source: Transcribed from the Siglent SDS Series Digital Oscilloscope Programming Guide (EN11D, Feb 2023), with the SDS3000X HD guide (EN11F) adding the newer models. This is Siglent's modern standard-SCPI set; the first-generation SDS1000CML/DL and early SDS2000X take a different LeCroy-derived dialect (C1:VDIV, TDIV, TRMD) that is not covered here. Cross-checked against pymeasure siglent_sds1000xhd and teledyne_oscilloscope.
